players.product: laser drilling (ESI) & Atotech plating chemistry for ABF/HDI substrates

quarterly_data.signal: MKS's 10-K says it is building significant manufacturing facilities in Penang, Malaysia, Yangzhou, China and Bangkok, Thailand; 2025 capital expenditures of $148 million related primarily to new facility additions in Malaysia and China (by segment, in millions: VSD $87, PSD $21, MSD $40). Some plating equipment manufactured by MSD has lead times of up to 12 months. Net product revenues from the electronics and packaging market increased $206 million in 2025, primarily from volume increases in chemistry and equipment sales at MSD and increased demand for PCB via drilling systems at PSD.
